messages.content: You are a candid adversarial reviewer. Preserve distinctions between evidence, inference and unknowns. Return a short final review with actionable acceptance checks.

You are an adversarial methodological reviewer of a public model dashboard. Review the following supplied evidence and proposed UX. This is advice, not independent benchmark validation. Do not claim to have inspected files, run models or validated anything beyond these supplied facts. Give a concise actionable review, maximum 1000 words.

PALO BlueprintBench currently has 18 distinct model IDs, 28 separate cohort/configuration records (18 new internal configurations and 10 older historical adapter diagnostics). The internal cohort uses 3 short synthetic procurement cases from one maintainer-authored family, 36 source rules, 108 seeded statements, 3 repetitions and two tasks (source-indexed translation and seeded-statement verification). There are 324 assigned request slots total: 306 dispatched, 299 complete, 7 failed/incomplete, 18 Sakana pre-call blocks. Per-model classification agreement denominator is 324 assigned probe judgments, distinct from the 324 total API call assignments. Labels were assistant drafts, not independent human gold. One contested invoice label remains frozen in the primary analysis; a uniform post-hoc exclusion lens is separate. Translation outputs for added models are unreviewed, not export-qualified. Historical adapter diagnostics use 3 tiny passages and different settings with no semantic ground truth, and must not be pooled with new tests. No PBI assigned; qualified_count=0 is true.

The owner wants a standard results-first leaderboard, to remove the large 'Current evidence / Internal tests / 0 independently qualified results' hero card, remove rhetorical 'Does may remain permission?' copy, remove public presentation links because the slide deck is internal, replace direct Markdown downloads with rendered GitHub document links, and make results filterable/sortable/comparable/exportable/challengeable. Plan: brief Internal tests label near results, detailed Method/Limits disclosure, no hero zero counter, per-model 'Challenge this result' GitHub issue composer with full result/source/configuration identifiers (never auto-submit), public CSV/JSON with scope metadata and explicit missing values, and links to pinned evidence commits. Schema JSON-LD uses CollectionPage + Dataset + BreadcrumbList with the actual logo; no ratings, certification or fake score.

Questions:
1. What exactly can an adversarial model counter-test establish, and what cannot it establish? What would legitimately make independently qualified_count nonzero?
2. Identify any scientifically misleading UX or naming in the proposal, and recommend precise labels/denominators without an alarmist front page.
3. Give six highest-priority acceptance checks for dashboard, export, challenge workflow and structured data.
4. Propose a bounded immediate adversarial counter-test on existing frozen cases whose result could honestly be labelled an internal robustness check, without changing frozen primary labels or spending money.
5. State a verdict on proceeding with this scoped internal-results dashboard and identify blocking defects versus research limitations.
